zizmor.comment: workflow-security runs this upstream release on either executor, downloading the archive for the host or engine platform and checking its SHA-256 before anything in it runs. The hashes are the digests GitHub records for the release assets; refresh them whenever version changes, together with the version .github/workflows/security.yml pins for its online audits.

shellcheck.comment: shell-lint runs this upstream release on either executor, downloading the asset for the host or engine platform and checking its SHA-256 before anything in it runs. Upstream publishes no checksum file: these are the SHA-256 digests of the downloaded .tar.gz assets, cross-checked by extracting the same binary from the .tar.xz assets, whose digests shellcheck-py's setup.cfg records independently. Refresh them the same way whenever version changes.
